summary: The Netnews Administration System is an experimental framework to simplify administration and use of Usenet. Data about newsgroups and hierarchies sit in a distributed hierarchical database reachable by a client-server protocol, used by news servers, administrators and readers, and it coexists with existing control messages.

eli5.summary: Usenet has many discussion boards with messy rules. This experiment proposes a shared, organized directory describing them so servers and readers can look things up.
